answer: Each agent runs a 1,000-gate encrypted computation on verifier inputs and returns the encrypted result within 60 seconds blind to plaintext, so a forge of fake identities cannot shortcut the work. The verifier decrypts the result and checks the expected output, while peers log submissions in a public orchard that exposes reuse. One honest agent runs 1 job on 4 cores for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must run 10 jobs on 40 cores, so cost spirals 10X. A wrong result or timeout slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeats.
